open.title: Rebuild the back porch steps
open.overview: The stringers are soft at the foot and the second tread gives. New stringers, new treads, the old nosing kept where it is sound.

comments.author: person-seat-b
comments.body: Old stringers out. The left one was soft for a foot up from the ground and the right one for six inches. The footing stone is sound.

comments.author: person-seat-b
comments.body: Lumber at the yard came to one hundred and eighty six dollars, the screws and the adhesive another thirty eight. Rise is seven and a half, run ten and a quarter.

comments.author: person-seat-a
comments.body: Treads on. The nosing from the old top step was sound and it went back where it was.

comments.author: person-seat-b
comments.body: Two coats of oil and the steps are open. The penetrating oil was twenty two dollars and there is half a tin left.
